text:
jade.ops: Heads up — the EU shipment into FRA is blocked by customs. broker flagged missing import license on 12/2, holding 48 H100 units.
marc.procurement: Ugh. I thought vendor sent docs with the AWB. @valeria.vendor can you confirm which import license you provided?
valeria.vendor: We submitted the batch under our general import permit (GL-2023-RED) — forwarding the broker note now. Looks like customs wants a customer-specific license or a declaration under HS code.
lia.logistics: Broker says they need either a client EORI + import license or the HS reclass. Current hold prevents scheduled DC handoff tomorrow.
customs-broker: Confirmed. We requested EORI: REDWOOD-EX-998 and license doc L-5599. If vendor can provide a commercial invoice with declared HS and license reference we can clear in 24-48h.
marc.procurement: @valeria.vendor please attach the commercial invoice and the vendor export license. If vendor can't provide REDWOOD's EORI, we can do a temporary import under vendor but that's extra fees and delays.
valeria.vendor: I can attach invoice right now. We can declare HS 8471.80.90 but vendor historically used 8542.* for accelerators — that mismatch might be why customs asked for extra docs. Sending invoice and packing list to thread.
kevin.sre: Operational impact — those 48 H100s were scheduled for the EU pool, we had two canaries queued for rollout. If cleared in 48h ok, but if longer we need to spin up loans from DCA pool — cost estimate?
jade.ops: Ballpark: overnight air loans cost ~€1200/unit plus duty handling. Sea delays add 5–10 business days. Which path does vendor prefer for partial clear?
valeria.vendor: We can split: clear 12 units by air (priority) under vendor temporary import and leave rest on hold for vendor-managed sea. Vendor will absorb expedited freight costs for first 8 units, remainder cost share.
lia.logistics: Need written confirmation and updated AWB for the 12 air. Also need RMA serial list reconciliation — broker flagged 3 serials that don't match PO manifest. If serials mismatch, customs will hold entire pallet until reconciliation.
marc.procurement: Which serials?
lia.logistics: Listed in the broker email (attached) as S/NO 1002, 1045, 1067 — manifest shows 1002, 1046, 1067. One discrepancy at 1045 vs 1046.
valeria.vendor: That's on us — packing error. We can confirm correct serials from vendor warehouse logs. Will provide a signed correction letter and new packing list within 2 hours.
ops-bot: deploy-notify: eu-provisioning-job-42 delayed due to inventory_hold, retry in 6h.
kevin.sre: If vendor fixes packing list + invoice and broker releases, what's ETA into FRA DC? Lia?
lia.logistics: If docs in 2h and customs clears same day, cleared cargo to DC in 24h. So earliest 36h from now for the 12 air units. Sea remainder unknown — depends on clearance window, probably 7–12 days.
marc.procurement: We need an RMA contingency plan: request vendor to pre-authorize loaner pool (10 units) for 30 days, with billing holdback. We also need vendor RMA window for the packing error (warranty/admin).
valeria.vendor: Can do 10 loaners under a loaner agreement, vendor will expedite PO amendment. RMA for packing error — vendor accepts responsibility, will waive RMA fees.
jade.ops: OK — next steps summarized: 1) @valeria.vendor attach commercial invoice + signed packing correction in thread (2h). 2) @customs-broker attempt conditional release on corrected docs. 3) @lia.logistics prepare air AWB for 12 units if vendor confirms expedited move. 4) @marc.procurement get PO amendment for loaners. 5) @kevin.sre prepare temporary routing to DCA pool if delay >72h.
marc.procurement: I'll prepare amendment now and ping procurement-legal.
customs-broker: Will monitor and update here. If customs insists on customer-specific license, we can file a deferred entry but that adds fees ~€450 and 3–5 day processing.
kevin.sre: Operational note — when units recon on our inventory please tag with lot:vendor-q3-242 to avoid mix in future.
lia.logistics: Filed. Also adding a short SOP step to check serial manifest vs packing list on arrival to avoid whole-pallet holds.
valeria.vendor: Uploaded invoice and corrected packing list to this thread (pdfs). Confirmed vendor will cover expedited freight for first 8 units and loaner terms in email to @marc.procurement.
jade.ops: Thanks. I'll watch broker updates and notify infra teams when items hit DC. :thumbsup:
marc.procurement: ping me if customs asks for any additional certification. If we can't get clearance in 48h, we'll accept air loans and chargeback vendor per agreement.
ops-bot: incident-tracker: created incident INFRA-EU-2023-07 for blocked provisioning — assigned to jade.ops.
